channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah: Oil gains and BI decision shape IDR – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note that Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) weakness is driven by higher Oil prices and elevated global yields, even as domestic sentiment improves after President Prabowo’s speeches and the BI governor nomination.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Rising 20-day EMA supports near-term bullish bias
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) underperforms its major currency peers on Wednesday, trading 0.17% lower at around 0.7070 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session.

item.title: Equities: Defensive rotation with higher yields – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team reports a marked drop in global equities, with the S&P 500 and Stoxx 600 down 0.7% on Tuesday. After a period of value-versus-growth rotation, flows shifted toward defensive sectors such as consumer staples and health care, funded by cyclicals.

item.title: Asia FX: Lower US yields offset Oil risk – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan notes that the Korean Won (KRW) and Taiwan Dollar (TWD) are leading Asia FX gains as softer US yields and a resilient technology cycle support sentiment.

item.title: Euro trims gains against British Pound after UK CPI inflation rises to 2.9%
item.description: The EUR/GBP cross pares gains around 0.8555 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The British Pound (GBP) attracts some buyers against the Euro (EUR) following the UK inflation data.

item.title: British Pound edges up within range following hotter UK inflation data
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) ticked up against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday, following the release of UK inflation data.

item.title: United Kingdom CPI inflation jumps to 2.9% YoY in July, as expected
item.description: The United Kingdom (UK) headline Consumer Price Index (CPI) climbed 2.9% over the year in July, compared to a rise of 2.6% in June, the data released by the Office for National Statistics (ONS) showed on Wednesday.

item.title: Japanese Yen: JGB spillover supports firmer JPY against US Dollar – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight that rising long-end Japanese government bond yields are increasingly influencing global curves and the Japanese Yen.

item.title: Gold surrenders modest intraday gains; trades below $4,450 as FOMC Minutes loom
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) surrenders modest intraday gains and trades near the lower end of its daily range, below $4,450 heading into the European session on Wednesday.

item.title: British Pound shows limited reaction to expected increase in UK headline inflation
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) reflects a slight market action against the Japanese Yen (JPY) near its day’s low at around 215.70 after the release of the United Kingdom (UK) Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for July.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah: BI seen hiking to anchor rupiah – UOB
item.description: UOB strategists highlight Bank Indonesia’s (BI) policy meeting, with consensus expecting no change but its macro team forecasting a 25 bps hike to 6.00%. They see risks around the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR), divided views on Federal Reserve (Fed) policy and rising global inflation.

item.title: Experts agree: Hawkish BoJ bets support Japanese Yen against US Dollar
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) recovers strongly against its major currency peers on Wednesday after underperforming in the past few days. The US Dollar (USD) is down 0.25% against the Japanese currency at around 159.20 during the early European trading session.

item.title: USD/IDR Price Forecast: Trades near 17,850 after pulling back from moving averages
item.description: USD/IDR depreciates after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around 17,870 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The technical analysis of the daily chart suggests that the pair is remaining within the rectangle, indicating a consolidation phase.

item.title: Indian Rupee holds onto two-week losses against US Dollar
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens on a flat note against the US Dollar (USD), but is close to its two-week low at around 95.75.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Gathers strength above 1.1550, bullish outlook remains intact
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades in positive territory near 1.1585 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The Euro (EUR) edges higher against the US Dollar (USD) as the German ZEW survey beat forecasts.

item.title: Swiss Franc strengthens as US Dollar falls on fading Fed rate hike expectations
item.description: USD/CHF depreciates after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around 0.8120 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair depreciates as the US Dollar (USD) weakens amid easing expectations of a US interest rate hike next month.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Sits near three-week high, below $85.00 as bulls eye 100-SMA breakout
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – touches a nearly three-week high during the Asian session on Wednesday, though it struggles to build on the momentum beyond the $85.00 mark.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Softens to near 184.50, mildly bearish bias persists under 100-day SMA
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross trades in negative territory around 184.60 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) edges higher against the Euro (EUR) amid hawkish signals from the Bank of Japan (BoJ).

item.title: Canadian Dollar strengthens as Trump pauses 50% tariffs and USD slides before FOMC Minutes
item.description: The USD/CAD pair meets with fresh supply during the Asian session on Wednesday and, for now, seems to have stalled its recovery from the lowest level since June 3, touched earlier this week.

item.title: Australian Dollar weakens despite RBA’s Hauser hawkish remarks
item.description: AUD/USD extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around 0.7080 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. Addressing the broader economic backdrop, Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser emphasized on Wednesday that inflation remains unacceptably high.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD extends decline to near $63 amid continued energy supply risks
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) is down 0.5% to near $63.00 during the Asian trading session on Wednesday. The white metal extends its Tuesday’s decline amid fears of prolonged inflation concerns on the back of continued energy supply disruption.

item.title: US President Trump: I have paused 50% tariffs against Canada
item.description: Following overnight negotiations with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, US President Donald Trump announced on Wednesday, “I have paused 50% tariffs against Canada for a three-day period.”

item.title: RBA’s Hauser: Will have to raise rates again if inflation doesn’t come down
item.description: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser said during the Asian trading session on Wednesday that inflation is too high and the central bank needs to raise interest rates to bring price pressures down.

item.title: Japanese Yen gains ground as BoJ rate hike bets rise
item.description: The USD/JPY pair edges lower to around 159.45 during the Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) as market expectations grow for another interest rate hike by the Bank of Japan (BoJ).

item.title: United States Dollar Index hovers above 99.50 due to safe-haven support
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is steadying after registering minor gains in the previous day and trading around 99.60 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar declines to weekly low as USD holds firm ahead of FOMC Minutes
item.description: The NZD/USD pair is seen extending this week's retracement slide from the 0.5925 area, or the highest since June 3, and drifting lower for the second straight day on Wednesday.

item.title: British Pound declines below 1.3550 on soft UK labour figures, traders brace for CPI data
item.description: The GBP/USD pair loses ground to around 1.3535 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The British Pound (GBP) weakens against the US Dollar (USD) amid disappointing UK labour data.

item.title: WTI rises to near $85.00 amid escalating US-Iran tensions
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price extends its gains for the fourth consecutive day, trading around $84.80 per barrel during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar consolidates near 1.3900 vs USD ahead of US tariffs deadline, FOMC Minutes
item.description: The USD/CAD pair struggles to capitalize on this week's modest recovery from its lowest level since June 3 and oscillates in a range around the 1.3900 mark during the Asian session on Wednesday.
